purpose: Teach: 除雪/透過/発芽/絶縁/局所/鮮度/生鮮/基板

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、雪国の除雪中事故の応急処置を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren — we're conducting research with our medical team on emergency response protocols for snow-removal accidents.
lines.style: Measured, professional opening. Steady delivery without performance. Clinical precision balanced with quiet care. She's briefing, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、X線の透過率を医療チームで日々確認します
lines.en: Yes — we check X-ray clarity with the team every day.
lines.style: Even pace, reassuring consistency. No performative warmth, but genuine commitment underneath. The tone of someone who has done this many times and takes it seriously each time.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、皮膚の発芽性嚢胞の処置を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren — we handle dermoid cyst removal procedures with our medical team.
lines.style: Same measured foundation as the first line. Slight emphasis on 「処置を」 — conveying clinical confidence without arrogance. Professional but not distant.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、電気メスの絶縁を医療チームで日々点検します
lines.en: Yes — we inspect the electrical scalpel insulation with the team daily.
lines.style: Same steady rhythm. Factual detail delivered without anxiety. The confidence of someone who knows safety protocols prevent catastrophe.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 局所麻酔の症例を、貴院、多く扱われますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital handles quite a lot of local anesthesia cases, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuinely curious but slightly tentative — testing the waters. Respectful hesitation on the opening. Soft landing on 「sensei」. Ren observing and asking, not performing knowledge.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、血液の鮮度を医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Yes — we manage blood quality with the team.
lines.style: Same assured cadence. No inflection on the technical detail. The tone says: this is routine and it matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 生鮮食品アレルギーの対策を、貴院、進められてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital is really advancing your approach to fresh-food allergies, aren't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Slightly more engaged than the first question. Small note of genuine interest — Ren has noticed something specific. Still respectful, but warmer. Seeking confirmation of something observed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療機器の基板トラブル対策も医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Yes — we're also working on medical equipment circuit board troubleshooting with the team.
lines.style: Slight closing-down of energy. Efficient, matter-of-fact. She's wrapping up her point, not inviting extension. Professional distance at the end of a long explanation.
